scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @raidschedule/server" "npm run dev -w @raidschedule/web"
scripts.dev:coi: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @raidschedule/server" "npm run dev:coi -w @raidschedule/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @raidschedule/shared && npm run build -w @raidschedule/web && npm run build -w @raidschedule/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @raidschedule/shared && tsc -b packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -b packages/web/tsconfig.json
